world_rules: In the visiting hall you may not pass anything across the table; you may show a photo but not hand it over; an officer watches; the visit ends when it is called.
Their mother is in a home and her mind is going; some days she does not know Lena, and this week she stopped asking after Danny.
Danny cannot leave, cannot help, and cannot be told a thing he can do nothing about without it being a cruelty.
Lena has told Danny for months that their mam sends her love and asks after him; it was true once and is not now.
objects: a recent photo of their mother, in Lena's pocket
the machine tea in a plastic cup
